LanguageData.OOCMSB.Title: Out Of Combat Move Speed Boost
LanguageData.OOCMSB.NonCombatSpeedMult.Label: Non-Combat Speed Multiplier
LanguageData.OOCMSB.NonCombatSpeedMult.TT: All pawns' movement speed will be multiplied by this value outside of combat.
LanguageData.OOCMSB.CombatSpeedMult.Label: Combat Speed Multiplier
LanguageData.OOCMSB.CombatSpeedMult.TT: Speed multiplier applied while combat is active.\n\nRecommended to leave at 1 for regular use of this mod. (Will affect combat balance)
LanguageData.OOCMSB.ShowBoostToggle.Label: Show Speed Boost Toggle
LanguageData.OOCMSB.ShowBoostToggle.TT: Show a button on the UI (bottom right) to manually toggle the effect.
LanguageData.OOCMSB.ManualReactivation.Label: Manual Reactivation
LanguageData.OOCMSB.ManualReactivation.TT: The effect will stay disabled after combat until manually re-enabled.
LanguageData.OOCMSB.DraftedDisable.Label: Disable When Drafted
LanguageData.OOCMSB.DraftedDisable.TT: Disable out of combat move speed boost when any colonists are drafted.
LanguageData.OOCMSB.OnOffNotification.Label: Enable Notification
LanguageData.OOCMSB.OnOffNotification.TT: Show a message when the effect is disabled / re-enabled.
